name: HOB
note: HOB ON HIS ROUNDS (doc 04 HOB_E6: 'Open once T_EXECUTOR_RULE is set and until E6 is complete; he is on his rounds at night (Main Street, the back alley)'; Tyler, 2026-11-05: the alley). His approved Room 1 drawing (art/actors/hob-idle-right), mirrored to face the gap Thad comes in by, scaled to the alley's curve at his feet by tools/art/room20-hob.py; no image operation. He stands before the Company's side door with his lantern, from Section nineteen said aloud (SUM_E1 option 2, T_EXECUTOR_RULE) until Sump accepts the form (T_EXECUTOR_NAMED, E6). His wrong verbs are doc 54 Room 20's Overrides (the room's peopleResponses). His id is his speaker id, so his lines are drawn over his head.
walkToNote: On the mud before the ash heap, a metre from him, facing him.
barksNote: Doc 04's 'Running' lines are the Act I road's; none is written for his rounds here.

sprite.frameNote: 0-5 facing left toward the gap, breathing, his lantern flickering · 6-8 turned to look down the alley the other way. A break every `breakEvery` seconds (errata 77).
